text:
sara_support: FYI escalating — multiple customers (ACME-123, NOMAD-77) reporting canary rollout health chart stuck on 'in progress' in Console since last night's deploy. Tickets opened, customers seeing their feature flagged as still rolling even though backend reports success.

sara_support: Repro steps I used: 1) Console -> Deployments -> select canary rollout -> health chart shows spinning 'in progress' 2) call API: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rollouts/rollout-abc/status` -> returns `{"state": "in_progress", "updated_at": "2026-03-16T23:05:12Z"}` even though aggregate metrics show 100% succeeded.

sara_support: Attached screenshots in ticket and a quick snippet of response headers. Customers are P1 because they can't rely on rollout gating. Any ideas? :worried:

maria_cs: thanks. how widespread? which regions? any customer impact besides the chart / gating?

sara_support: so far ACME on us-west and NOMAD on eu-west. Their traffic is correctly routed to new variant; only the Console/analytics UI and the health timeline are wrong. One customer tried to toggle canary off/on which temporarily forced a sync.

tim_ops: copying eng-sre. can you paste a sample raw response body plus headers and ticket ids? also pinging deploy-bot to see recent canary deploy details.

sara_support: pasted curl output above and ticket ids (ACME-123, NOMAD-77). deploy-bot: @deploy-bot what rolled last night?

deploy-bot: [deploy] prod-canary rollout-20260316-1912 deployed to canary (git: a1b2c3d) by ci/cd.

analytics-bot: [alert] rollout.health.metrics delayed: rollout.health.* metrics ingestion lag 45m for canary namespace (since 2026-03-16T23:20:00Z).

tim_ops: ok two signals: metric ingestion lag and API status still shows in_progress. probable sync job issue between status-sync service and metrics aggregator. can someone grab logs for status-sync-worker and the status-aggregator? `kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=status-sync --tail=200`

liam_eng: grabbing logs now. quick paste of stack trace from status-sync-worker pod (truncated):
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/sync_worker.py", line 214, in process_event
    state = payload['status']['phase']
KeyError: 'phase'
```

liam_eng: looks like an incoming event didn't have `phase` key after a change in the rollout controller schema. We're dropping the event, so the DB never gets mark-as-complete, and UI remains "in_progress".

tim_ops: aha. schema mismatch. did that controller change go out in the a1b2c3d commit?

liam_eng: yes, controller added optional `phase` -> sometimes omitted for legacy entries. status-sync code assumed presence. quick mitigation: patch sync_worker to use `.get('phase')` and fallback to `status` field, and run backfill to reprocess skipped events.

maria_cs: is there a manual customer workaround we can give ACME/NOMAD until patch lands?

liam_eng: short term: toggling canary flag off then on forces a fresh status event and will update the chart. Or run the API admin endpoint: `POST /admin/rollouts/{id}/force-sync` (requires admin token). Not ideal but works.

sara_support: passing workaround to both customers now. will notify when patch is live.

liam_eng: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4523 — includes guard for missing `phase` and small requeue for unprocessed events. Rolling canary patch in 15m.

tim_ops: also need to re-run the backfill job to reprocess events between 2026-03-16T22:30 and 2026-03-17T00:00. I'll kick it off after patch.

liam_eng: patch applied to canary at 1768507921, backfill started. logs show previously skipped events now processed, DB update applied for rollout-abc and rollout-def.

analytics-bot: [info] metrics ingestion lag resolved. rollout.health.* latency normalizing.

liam_eng: finally cleared cache on Console for the affected rollouts. verify in UI now.

maria_cs: confirmed with ACME rep — charts now show succeeded and gating is green. NOMAD also verified. I'll close out the tickets with notes about the temporary workaround + root cause.

sara_support: thanks team. TL;DR: root cause = status-sync worker assumed `phase` key after schema change -> KeyError -> events dropped -> UI stuck. Patch + backfill fixed it. Please add a small unit test for missing-phase events. :thumbsup:

liam_eng: will add test in follow-up. marking this thread resolved.
